This bright and spacious 1,189 sq. ft. one-level townhome offers comfortable living in one of Vancouver’s most desirable neighbourhoods. Located in the heart of Kitsilano, near Arbutus Walk, this well-maintained home is ideal for a family, professionals, or anyone looking to enjoy the best of West Side living.

✨ Features:
2 spacious bedrooms
2 full bathrooms
1,200 sq. ft. of comfortable living space
Underground parking included
Bright, windowed kitchen with plenty of oak cabinetry and counter space
New Stainless steel appliances
Generous eating area
Spacious living and dining rooms
Cozy gas fireplace
Hardwood floors
Enclosed deck
In-suite laundry
New paint throughout
New carpet in bedrooms
New appliances, including washer and dryer
Baseboards and crown mouldings throughout
Beautiful North Shore mountain views
Pet friendly!

NON- Furnished

📍 Prime Kitsilano Location

Situated right on the W 10th Avenue bike route and just half a block from Burrard Street, you'll have easy access to:

Shops, restaurants, and cafes along 4th Avenue
Broadway and Granville Street
Arbutus Walk and nearby parks
Public transit virtually at your doorstep
Downtown Vancouver and UBC

Enjoy the convenience of city living while coming home to a quiet, spacious townhome.

💰 Rental Details:

Monthly Rent: $3,600
Available: Now
Pets: Welcome
Parking: Underground parking included
